_comment: Composite score specification. A score is a weighted mean of per-metric pooled rates, rescaled to 0-100. Consumers MUST iterate the keys of each score's `weights` map rather than a hardcoded metric list, so adding a metric here is never a silent no-op. `metric` names must match the per-metric record keys emitted by 03_metric_records.py.

ltvv.label: Low tidal volume ventilation (<= 8 mL/kg PBW)

sat.label: Spontaneous awakening trial on eligible vent-days

sbt.label: Spontaneous breathing trial on eligible vent-days

_comment_scores: score_core is the PRIMARY exposure. Proning is excluded from it because its denominator is a severity-defined cohort roughly two orders of magnitude smaller than the vent-day denominators (682 PROSEVA-eligible patients vs ~60,400 SAT vent-days at UChicago 2018-2024), so at equal weight it would dominate the composite's noise without contributing comparable signal. score_full is the prespecified sensitivity analysis including it. All four metrics are computed and stored regardless of score membership.
_comment_scale: Rates are pooled (sum(numerator)/sum(denominator)) and multiplied by 100. Weights are normalized to sum to 1 within each score, so equal integer weights give a plain mean.
